verdict.rationale: Generating insights from user data is the platform's core function. Kosmos takes a research objective plus the user's uploaded datasets and autonomously writes and runs analysis code, generates hypotheses, and produces a cited report with figures. The Analysis agent turns raw experimental data (flow cytometry, RNA-seq) into statistical results, and data upload, artifact retrieval, and chat sessions with follow-up questions are documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and documentation of the in-app (non-API) experience, since most evidence describes the Python client.
